objectives: Locate where the sons of Japheth, Ham and Shem settled.
Explain who Nimrod was and how his worship spread through the nations.
takeaways: Japheth settled Europe; Ham settled Africa; the Israelites are of Shem, scattered among the children of Ham.
Canaan's land is the land of Israel, so the land of Israel is part of Africa.
Nimrod, Semiramis and Tammuz became the first pagan trinity, worshipped under many names.
Sunday sacredness, Christmas and Easter come from Babylonian sun worship, not the scriptures; study precept upon precept.
Eber is where the name Hebrew comes from (Genesis 10:21).
